answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on bond keyed to a hardware root, converted to a slow vesting stream, each submission carries a fresh nonce. The spiral holds work receipts rather than names, so the kernel of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. The ember of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
